title: Touch Weather Station

design.status: no validated native fabrication CAD/3D model in MAKHEX package

preflight: Identify the precise display controller, touch chip and backlight pin mapping from the purchased board.
Confirm the BME280 uses 3.3 V and that its I2C pins do not conflict with the display.
steps: Identify the exact display and touch controller SKU.
Verify display firmware alone before adding peripherals.
Read BME280 sensor values over verified I²C pins.
Build LVGL screen states and stale-data warnings.
Stress-test touch, power and thermal behavior.
acceptance: A live temperature/humidity reading appears with a last-updated timestamp.
Touch works for 30 minutes without freezes or phantom presses.
Unplugging the sensor produces a visible stale-data warning rather than a fabricated reading.
agentTasks: Map actual screen/touch GPIO from the board schematic before writing display drivers.
Provide a minimal sensor example and LVGL build instructions with a reproducible flash log.
caution: Controller, I²C bus and GPIO maps are board-dependent; never rely on generic wiring.
